```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The racial wealth and income gaps are the result of policies that discriminate against people of color and constrain their ability to earn income and build assets to the same extent as other Americans.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The racial wealth and income gaps have accumulated over time and are made worse by ongoing policies and practices.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"African Americans and Latinos lost more than half of their net worth as a result of the housing crisis and the Great Recession.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"African Americans and Latinos lost jobs at a much faster rate than white workers during the housing crisis and the Great Recession.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"African Americans and Latinos were disproportionately targeted for subprime, predatory, and fraudulent mortgages during the run-up to the housing crisis.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats believe it is long past time to close the racial wealth gap.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Disparities in wealth cannot be solved by the free market alone, but instead, the federal government must play a role in eliminating systemic barriers to wealth accumulation for different racial groups and improving opportunities for people from all racial and ethnic backgrounds to build wealth.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Federal policies must remove barriers to achieving sustainable homeownership.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Federal policies must provide for greater diversity in federal and state contracting practices.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Federal policies must incentivize and expand access to retirement investment programs.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Federal policies must increase opportunities for quality jobs and education.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Federal policies must challenge the deeply rooted structures that perpetuate and exacerbate current disparities and ultimately stagnate the nation's economic growth and security.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
